LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays a payment amount in its currency and the viewer's locale, formatted like the FinDock Pay button: as a heading, in a line of text, or in an opt-in checkbox label.

property.name: currencyIsoCode
property.label: Currency ISO code
property.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the org currency. In a multi-currency org, pass the payment currency.

property.name: variant
property.label: Variant
property.description: heading shows the amount on its own, text shows it in a line such as a total, checkbox shows it in an opt-in label such as a cover fee.

property.name: label
property.label: Label
property.description: Optional text around the amount. Use {0} for the amount, for example Total {0} or Cover fees for this donation (+{0}).

property.name: value
property.label: Checked
property.description: Checkbox variant only: true when the payer selects the checkbox.
